assumptions.choice: States contain SMA relation, RSI buckets (<30, 30-70, >70), MACD-versus-signal direction, and Bollinger-band location. BUY is oversold/bullish-MACD/below-lower-band; SELL is overbought/bearish-MACD/above-upper-band; all other states produce NOTHING.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires discretized states but does not define state boundaries, a trained policy, Q-learning parameters, rewards, or a state-to-action mapping.

assumptions.choice: A SELL signal closes an open long position and a BUY signal closes an open short position.
assumptions.reason: The specification names exit states but does not define separate exit-state mappings.

assumptions.choice: Order size is 10% of current broker total value divided by the current close.
assumptions.reason: This implements 10% of total trading capital; the specification does not define share rounding.

assumptions.choice: Entries use market orders; stop-loss and take-profit orders are submitted after the entry fills, using the actual executed entry price.
assumptions.reason: The entry price is unknown until a market order executes, while the required 2% stop-loss and 4% take-profit are defined from entry price.
